name: ballerina/udp
description: This module provides APIs for sending/receiving datagrams to/from another application process (local or remote) using UDP.

typeDefs.name: ConnectClientConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Configurations for the connection oriented udp client.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description:
The socket reading timeout value to be used 
in seconds. If this is not set,the default value
of 300 seconds (5 minutes) will be used

typeDefs.name: Datagram
typeDefs.description:
A self-contained, independent entity of data carrying sufficient information
to be routed from the source to the destination nodes without reliance
on earlier exchanges between the nodes and the transporting network.

fields.name: remoteHost
fields.description: The hostname or the IP address of the remote host

fields.name: remotePort
fields.description: The port number of the remote host

fields.name: data
fields.description: The content which needs to be transported to the remote host

typeDefs.name: ClientConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Configurations for the connectionless UDP client.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description:
The socket-reading timeout value to be used 
in seconds. If this is not set,the default value
of 300 seconds (5 minutes) will be used

fields.name: remoteHost
fields.description: The hostname or the IP address of the remote host

fields.name: remotePort
fields.description:
The remote host's port number. If this is not set, the server
runs without connecting to a remote host

fields.name: localHost
fields.description: The interface for the server to be bound

typeDefs.name: Listener
typeDefs.description:
Initializes the UDP listener based on the privovided configurations. 
```ballerina
 listener Listener|error? udpServer = new (8080);
```

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the UDP listener based on the privovided configurations. 
```ballerina
 listener Listener|error? udpServer = new (8080);
```

parameters.name: localPort
parameters.description: The port number of the remote service

parameters.name: remoteHost
parameters.description: The hostname or the IP address of the remote host

parameters.name: remotePort
parameters.description:
The remote host's port number. If this is not set, the server
runs without connecting to a remote host

parameters.name: localHost
parameters.description: The interface for the server to be bound

parameters.name: Additional Values
parameters.description: Capture key value pairs

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Configurations related to the `udp:Listener`

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Binds a service to the `udp:Listener`.
```ballerina
udp:error? result = udpListener.attach(helloService);
```

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Type descriptor of the service

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the service

return.description:
`()` or else a `udp:Error` upon failure to register
the listener

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Stops the service listener gracefully. Already-accepted requests will be
served before connection closure.

return.description:
An `error` if an error occurred during the listener
stopping process

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description: Stops the service listener immediately. It is not implemented yet.

return.description:
An `error` if an error occurred during the listener
stop process

functions.name: detach
functions.description:
Stops consuming messages and detaches the service from the `udp:Listener`.
```ballerina
udp:error? result = udpListener.detach(helloService);
```

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Type descriptor of the service

return.description: `()` or else a `udp:Error` upon failure to detach the service

clients.name: ConnectClient
clients.description:
Initializes the UDP connection oriented client based on the 
provided configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the UDP connect client based on the 
provided configurations.
```ballerina
udp:ConnectClient|udp:Error? socketClient = new("www.remote.com", 80,
                             localHost = "localHost");
```

parameters.name: remoteHost
parameters.description: The hostname or the IP address of the remote host

parameters.name: remotePort
parameters.description: The port number of the remote host

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description:
The socket reading timeout value to be used 
in seconds. If this is not set,the default value
of 300 seconds (5 minutes) will be used

parameters.name: localHost
parameters.description: Local binding of the interface

parameters.name: Additional Values
parameters.description: Capture key value pairs

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Connection oriented client related configuration

functions.name: writeBytes
functions.description:
Sends the given data to the connected remote host.
```ballerina
udp:Error? result = socketClient->writeBytes("msg".toBytes());
```

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data need to be sent to the connected remote host

return.description: `()` or else a `udp:Error` if the given data can't be sent

functions.name: readBytes
functions.description:
Reads data only from the connected remote host. 
```ballerina
readonly & byte[]|udp:Error result = socketClient->readBytes();
```

return.description:
A `byte[]` or else a `udp:Error` if the data
cannot be read from the remote host

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Free up the occupied socket.
```ballerina
udp:Error? closeResult = socketClient->close();
```

return.description: A `udp:Error` if it can't close the connection or else `()`

clients.name: Client
clients.description: Initializes the UDP connectionless client based on the provided configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the UDP connectionless client based on the provided 
configurations.
```ballerina
udp:Client|udp:Error? socketClient = new(localHost = "localhost");
```

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description:
The socket-reading timeout value to be used 
in seconds. If this is not set,the default value
of 300 seconds (5 minutes) will be used

parameters.name: localHost
parameters.description: Local binding of the interface

parameters.name: Additional Values
parameters.description: Capture key value pairs

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Connectionless client-related configuration

return.description: `()` or else a `udp:Error` if the given data cannot be sent

functions.name: sendDatagram
functions.description:
Sends the given data to the specified remote host.
```ballerina
udp:Error? result = socketClient->sendDatagram({remoteHost: "localhost",
           remotePort: 48826, data:"msg".toBytes()});
```

parameters.name: datagram
parameters.description:
Contains the data to be sent to the remote host
and the address of the remote host

return.description: `()` or else a `udp:Error` if the given data cannot be sent

functions.name: receiveDatagram
functions.description:
Reads data from the remote host. 
```ballerina
udp:Datagram|udp:Error result = socketClient->receiveDatagram();
```

return.description:
A `udp:Datagram` or else a `udp:Error` if the data
cannot be read from the remote host

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Free up the occupied socket.
```ballerina
udp:Error? closeResult = socketClient->close();
```

return.description: A `udp:Error` if it can't close the connection or else `()`
